NV holds 385 tons of room per
The national median state holds 43 tons of room per resident. Below the orange diagonal a state has under twenty years at its current rate, whoever is generating the waste.
Per-resident normalisation is what makes states comparable at all, and it is also what exposes the import problem: a state can look profligate because it is taking someone else's rubbish.
45 states qualify. Population is the Census 2023 county estimate summed to state; capacity and rate are the register's own reported figures for open sites.
